Traffic Advisory
Day 2, 19th September, 2025

Construction of Northern Parkway from Ring Road II to III along Shehu Yar Adua Way, Lifecamp Roundabout.

The attention of the FCT motoring public is hereby drawn to the flag-off of construction of the Northern Parkway at Lifecamp Roundabout and the need to adhere to traffic control signs and personnel that will be deployed to ensure free flow of traffic within and around the venue of the event.

Alternative Routes:
a) Linked roads to connect to Herbert Macaulay Road, linking Jabi and other locations.

b) Asba Dantata road to link Ahmadu Bello Expressway.

c) Kado Estate roads to link Ahmadu Bello expressway.
Your patience is highly solicited as Traffic and security personnel will be deployed accordingly.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
